name: @laikacms/starter-pages-blog
description: Starter blog built with Cloudflare Pages Functions + R2 + LaikaCMS. Shows how to wire decapApi with R2StorageRepository for edge runtimes where createEmbeddedLaika (Node.js / FileSystem) is not available.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:admin && wrangler pages dev public --compatibility-date=2024-12-01 --compatibility-flags=nodejs_compat
